role: Port of MapGenBase, MapGenCaves and MapGenRavine: carves caves and ravines into one chunk's raw block array (x<<12|z<<8|y layout) from every source chunk within range 8, with Java's Random draw order split into statements.

structs.name: cave_ctx
structs.java: MapGenBase call arguments (chunk coords, biome array, block array)

gpu: line 128 and 131, function tunnel: recursive call for the two branch tunnels (depth bounded because branches get width <= 1.0 and do not branch again, but still recursion)
line 260, function carve_pass: source carver passed as a function pointer (cave_source or ravine_source)
line 202, function ravine: 256-float width profile on the stack per ravine
notes: field_75046_d is MapGenRavine's per-height width array (profile here); name taken from the Java source by assumption, not re-verified member by member. Loops are bounded by steps (at most 112) and the 17x17 source window.
